package.name: easyfleet_example_deployments
package.description: Deployment scenarios that assemble robots out of capability implementations. Ships the "fake"/mock navigation, manipulation and perception capabilities (reference implementations of the easyfleet_core NavigationActionServerBase / ManipulationActionServerBase / PerceptionActionServerBase classes), the "alone" and "collaboration" example mission scripts built on easyfleet_mission_manager, plus the launch files and per-robot JSON/parameter configuration each capability instance is started with. A real integrator would add their own backend (Nav2, EasyNav, a vendor SDK, ...) as a sibling package following the same pattern.
